correctness.rationale: For every real n-vector the sharp elementary bounds (n-1)D<=G<=floor(n^2/4)D yield both operator comparisons. The constants are attained by explicit n-state positive bistochastic rank-one perturbations of J, using exact dual seminorm identities. Four-state positive symmetric PSD witnesses are graph-Laplacian perturbations with all binary-cut norms computed exactly. All boundary and range quantifiers are covered; finite code is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sharp transfer between consensus/Markov contraction measures has natural interpretation and separates oscillation from total pairwise dispersion. Both best constants are shown attainable under strict positivity and bistochasticity, with unavoidable loss growing linearly in state count. At first possible dimension, even reversible positive-semidefinite kernels yield opposite orderings, demonstrating no universal ranking under strong common stability hypotheses.
